No local annual headword set found. Raw query responses containing restricted public-reply text are excluded from integration; retain research metadata/title/URL citations only.

source_candidate_notes.title: 青岛 local annual English vocabulary discovery, 2022–2026

source_candidate_notes.title: 临沂 local annual English vocabulary discovery, 2022–2026
caveats: Bounded public municipal/county index in its visible 全市 scope. Whole-phrase and AND syntax were validated against a known relevant control. Complete 42-row 英语词汇 and one-row 词汇表 broad indexes, plus all five exact annual AND sets (28/23/22/28/24), were reviewed. The 95 unique broad/annual result URLs include teaching plans, teaching awards, catalogues, vocational/high-school/primary-school material and general news, not a retained local annual headword set. Actual year tokens may also match cited curriculum-standard years. Five actual teaching-plan pages were opened. A single index does not establish universal absence.
